#!/bin/sh
# Manage the branch worker without trusting a PID file on its own.
set -u

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
worker="$base/worker.py"
pidfile="$base/run/worker.pid"
lockdir="$base/run/control.lock"
python=$(command -v python) || {
    echo "python is not installed" >&2
    exit 1
}
python=$(readlink -f "$python")
action=${1-}

valid_pid()
{
    case "$1" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*|0) return 1 ;;
        *) return 0 ;;
    esac
}

pid_exists()
{
    valid_pid "$1" && kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null
}

pid_is_worker()
{
    p=$1
    pid_exists "$p" || return 1
    [ -r "/proc/$p/cmdline" ] || return 1
    proc_exe=$(readlink -f "/proc/$p/exe" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
    [ "$proc_exe" = "$python" ] || return 1
    tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$p/cmdline" | grep -F -x -- "$worker" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

read_pid()
{
    pid=
    [ -f "$pidfile" ] || return 1
    IFS= read -r pid < "$pidfile" || true
    return 0
}

release_lock()
{
    rm -f "$lockdir/pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    rmdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null || true
}

acquire_lock()
{
    attempts=0
    while ! mkdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null; do
        lock_pid=
        lock_start=
        lock_boot=
        if [ -r "$lockdir/pid" ]; then
            set -- $(cat "$lockdir/pid" 2>/dev/null)
            lock_pid=${1-}
            lock_start=${2-}
            lock_boot=${3-}
        fi
        current_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null || true)
        current_start=
        if valid_pid "$lock_pid" && [ -r "/proc/$lock_pid/stat" ]; then
            current_start=$(cut -d ' ' -f 22 "/proc/$lock_pid/stat" 2>/dev/null || true)
        fi
        if [ -z "$lock_pid" ] || [ "$lock_start" != "$current_start" ] || [ "$lock_boot" != "$current_boot" ]; then
            rm -f "$lockdir/pid" 2>/dev/null || true
            rmdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null || true
        else
            attempts=$((attempts + 1))
            if [ "$attempts" -ge 100 ]; then
                echo "control operation is busy" >&2
                return 1
            fi
            sleep 0.1
        fi
    done
    own_start=$(cut -d ' ' -f 22 /proc/$$/stat 2>/dev/null || true)
    own_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null || true)
    printf '%s %s %s\n' "$$" "$own_start" "$own_boot" > "$lockdir/pid"
    trap 'release_lock' 0 1 2 3 15
}

case "$action" in
    status)
        if ! read_pid; then
            echo "stopped: no PID file"
            exit 1
        elif ! valid_pid "$pid" || ! pid_exists "$pid"; then
            echo "stale PID file: ${pid:-empty}"
            exit 1
        elif pid_is_worker "$pid"; then
            echo "running: branch worker PID $pid"
            exit 0
        else
            echo "foreign PID: $pid belongs to another process"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;

    start)
        acquire_lock || exit 1
        if read_pid; then
            if valid_pid "$pid" && pid_is_worker "$pid"; then
                echo "already running: branch worker PID $pid"
                exit 0
            elif valid_pid "$pid" && pid_exists "$pid"; then
                echo "ignoring foreign PID $pid; unrelated process left running"
            else
                echo "removing stale PID file: ${pid:-empty}"
            fi
            rm -f "$pidfile"
        fi

        "$python" "$worker" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
        pid=$!
        tmp="$pidfile.$$"
        printf '%s\n' "$pid" > "$tmp"
        mv -f "$tmp" "$pidfile"

        checks=0
        while [ "$checks" -lt 20 ]; do
            if pid_is_worker "$pid"; then
                echo "started: branch worker PID $pid"
                exit 0
            fi
            checks=$((checks + 1))
            sleep 0.1
        done
        rm -f "$pidfile"
        echo "branch worker failed to start" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;

    stop)
        acquire_lock || exit 1
        if ! read_pid; then
            echo "already stopped: no PID file"
            exit 0
        elif ! valid_pid "$pid" || ! pid_exists "$pid"; then
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            echo "removed stale PID file: ${pid:-empty}"
            exit 0
        elif ! pid_is_worker "$pid"; then
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            echo "removed foreign PID file for $pid; unrelated process left running"
            exit 0
        fi

        kill "$pid"
        checks=0
        while [ "$checks" -lt 50 ]; do
            pid_is_worker "$pid" || break
            checks=$((checks + 1))
            sleep 0.1
        done
        if pid_is_worker "$pid"; then
            echo "branch worker PID $pid did not stop" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        rm -f "$pidfile"
        echo "stopped: branch worker PID $pid"
        exit 0
        ;;

    *)
        echo "usage: $0 {start|stop|status}" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
CONTROL_EOF
